acceptanceCriteria.description: A live POST to https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/siteverify with secret=1x0000000000000000000000000000000AA and any response token returns success:true; the pack-fixture /api/submit handler proceeds with 200. The Node siteverify-fixture probe drives the live endpoint and asserts success:true.
